tasks.title: Enterprise-Grade Security Testing Framework Implementation for AIgent Ecosystem
tasks.description:
Design and implement a comprehensive enterprise-grade security testing framework that provides automated security validation, advanced penetration testing capabilities, vulnerability scanning, continuous security monitoring, and compliance validation for the entire AIgent ecosystem.

Phase 1: Automated Security Test Suite Enhancement
- Expand existing security test utilities with ML-enhanced attack payload generators
- Implement automated security validation for input validation testing (SQL injection, XSS, command injection, path traversal, LDAP injection, XXE attacks)
- Create advanced authentication and authorization testing with JWT token validation and tampering, session management, OAuth2/OIDC flows
- Build comprehensive API security testing including rate limiting effectiveness, CORS violations, security headers validation
- Add infrastructure security testing for secrets management, configuration security, container security scanning

Phase 2: Advanced Penetration Testing Engine
- Design realistic attack simulation engine based on OWASP Top 10 and real-world attack patterns
- Implement multi-vector testing capabilities for combined attack scenarios
- Create performance-under-attack testing for security resilience during high-load attacks and DDoS simulation
- Add social engineering simulation integration for comprehensive human factors security testing

Phase 3: Real-Time Security Monitoring Integration
- Build real-time vulnerability detection system with automated scanning and alerting
- Create security metrics dashboard with Grafana integration and comprehensive security KPIs
- Implement threat intelligence integration with external threat feed correlation and analysis
- Design incident response automation with automated containment and mitigation workflows

Phase 4: Compliance and Enterprise Reporting
- Implement OWASP Top 10 validation with automated compliance checking against security standards
- Add NIST Cybersecurity Framework implementation validation and gap analysis
- Create enterprise security standards support with custom compliance rule engine and validation
- Build comprehensive audit logging system with security event correlation and audit trail generation

Technology Stack Implementation:
- Python asyncio-based testing framework with comprehensive security libraries
- Custom ML-enhanced attack simulation with advanced payload generators and ML-enhanced patterns
- Prometheus/Grafana monitoring integration with custom security metrics
- Executive and technical security reporting engine with actionable insights and compliance verification

Success Criteria:
- 100% security coverage across all attack vectors and vulnerabilities
- Real-time security validation with sub-5-second response times
- Zero false positives through intelligent validation algorithms
- Enterprise-grade reporting with compliance verification
- Automated threat detection and response capabilities
- Integration with existing orchestrator security infrastructure
